name: NN-tab
description: A very minimal new tab page for Chrome, for people who want a quiet screen when they open a tab.

name: Copilot2Gemini
description: Turns the Copilot key on Windows into a Google Gemini key, opening and hiding Gemini as a neat app window instead of a browser tab.
home_blurb: Turns the Copilot key on Windows into a Google Gemini key, and keeps its window behaving.

name: Hotspot-Auto-Connect
description: Connects my PC to my phone's hotspot, or my usual Wi-Fi, the moment I unlock it. No more clicking through the network menu.
home_blurb: Connects my PC to my phone's hotspot or my usual Wi-Fi the moment I unlock it.

name: AlwaysNumLock
description: Keeps Num Lock switched on, always, so the number pad never surprises you.

name: leaflet
description: An invoice generator that runs entirely in your browser: fill in the items, and it calculates totals and exports a clean A4 PDF. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
home_blurb: Makes A4 PDF invoices right in the browser. Nothing leaves your computer.

name: Highlighter
description: A simple, distraction-free text highlighter for Chrome.

name: remit-bd
description: A calculator for sending money home: converts Romanian leu to Bangladeshi taka at current rates and adds Bangladesh's 2.5% government remittance incentive.

name: video-showcase-paul
description: The code behind my [video editing showcase](https://video-showcase.mogdhopaul.com/), a single-page portfolio for my edits.
